September 2, 2026


Strong communities are built through connection, opportunity and inspiring leadership. That's why Cameco was proud to support the[Saskatoon Public Schools Foundation](https://facebook.com/449936011867683) ConnectHer event as sponsor of the ConnectHer Marketplace, showcasing the incredible women-owned businesses helping shape our community. Bringing together students, professionals and community leaders, ConnectHer creates opportunities for meaningful conversations and shared learning for the next generation of leaders. We were honoured to have Senior Vice-President and Chief Marketing Officer Lisa Aitken introduce feature speaker and Cameco board member Chief Tammy Cook-Searson, whose leadership continues to empower people across Saskatchewan. A wonderful evening dedicated to uplifting others and investing in the next generation. 🩷
